summary.headline: Planetary Exaltations and Natures
summary.text: Discussion of planetary exaltations and depressions: Cancer for Zeus (Jupiter), Capricorn for Ares (Mars), Pisces for Aphrodite (Venus), and Virgo for Hermes (Mercury), justified by planetary qualities, moisture, dryness, and diametrical opposition. Albumasar’s Introductorium, book IV, chapter 1, summarizes Ptolemy’s planetary natures and distances, including the Moon’s distance from Earth, and refutes Ptolemaic doctrines concerning the fixed stars.
